form.label: CVE encyclopaedia
form.description: Everything the imported feed knows about one vulnerability, and where it sits in this fleet.

div.b: Offline. Nothing here is looked up on the internet.
div.span: Every field below the fleet table comes from the bundle you imported, so it reads the same on any instance holding the same feed. A CVE the feed has never heard of returns nothing, which is not the same as a CVE that is harmless: check Coverage to see which sources the bundle actually carries.

search.query: `riskability_cve_facts($cve_tok$)` | eval v = if(isnull(cvss_score), "not scored", tostring(round(cvss_score,1))) | fields v
`riskability_cve_facts($cve_tok$)` | eval v = if(isnull(epss), "unscored", tostring(round(epss*100,1)) . "%") | fields v
`riskability_cve_facts($cve_tok$)` | eval v = if(kev_added != "", "YES", "not listed") | fields v
| inputlookup riskability_findings_state_lookup where cve_id="$cve_tok$" AND status="open" | stats dc(hostname) AS v

`riskability_cve_facts($cve_tok$)` | eval Product = if(kev_name != "", kev_name, "not named by the feed") | eval Name = if(kev_title != "", kev_title, "") | eval Description = case(kev_description != "", kev_description, best_title != "", best_title, 1=1, "No description in any advisory the bundle carries for this CVE.") | eval "What CISA requires" = if(kev_action != "", kev_action, "") | eval Published = published, Modified = modified | table Product, Name, Description, "What CISA requires", Published, Modified | transpose 6 column_name="Field" header_field=Product | rename "Field" AS " ", "not named by the feed" AS " "

viz.option: No advisory for that CVE in this feed.

search.query: | inputlookup riskability_cvedetail_lookup where cve_id="$cve_tok$" | eval Product = if(products!="", replace(products, "\n", ", "), "not named by the CVE record") | eval Description = if(description!="", description, "The CVE record carries no English description.") | eval Weakness = if(cwes!="", cwes, "") | eval "Published by" = trim(assigner . " " . published) | table Product, Description, Weakness, "Published by"

viz.option: Not in the CVE Program catalogue. Either this bundle was built without the CVE Program source, or the id was published after the bundle was built. It says nothing about whether the vulnerability affects this fleet.

div.span: From the CVE Program's own record, which is the only source in the feed that names a product the way a person would rather than as a package identifier. It arrives with the feed you imported, so it is present on every search head the feed reached and nothing here touches the network. Empty means the bundle was built without the CVE Program source.

panel.title: What an attacker needs, read from the CVSS vector

search.query: `riskability_cve_facts($cve_tok$)` | `riskability_cvss_english` | table Vector, Reach, Complexity, Privileges, "User interaction", Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability

viz.option: No CVSS vector for this CVE in the feed.

div.span: This is the vector spelled out, nothing more. It describes the vulnerability as published, not this fleet: whether your copy answers a network address is on the Exposure page, and it is a different question.

panel.title: Weakness class, and the techniques it would enable

search.query: `riskability_cve_facts($cve_tok$)` | fields cwes | mvexpand cwes | rename cwes AS cwe | where cwe != "" | lookup riskability_attack_lookup cwe OUTPUT technique, technique_name, tactics, via_capec | eval Technique = if(isnull(technique), "no ATT&CK mapping in this bundle", technique . " " . technique_name) | eval Tactics = mvjoin(tactics, ", ") | eval Route = if(via_capec="1", "via CAPEC", "direct") | stats values(Technique) AS Technique, values(Tactics) AS Tactics, values(Route) AS Route BY cwe | rename cwe AS CWE

viz.option: No weakness class recorded for this CVE. Around a third of advisories carry no CWE, and the ATT&CK mapping needs the MITRE source in the bundle.

search.query: | inputlookup riskability_findings_state_lookup where cve_id="$cve_tok$" | eval rk_key = if(match(coalesce(scope_id, ""), "^container:"), "container:" . substr(replace(scope_id, "^container:", ""), 1, 12), package) | lookup riskability_reach_lookup hostname, rk_key OUTPUT reach_class | eval Reach = coalesce(reach_class, "not assessed") | eval Accepted = if(accepted="1", "yes", "") | table hostname, package, last_version, fixed_version, scope, scope_id, confidence, Reach, status, Accepted, first_seen | rename hostname AS Host, package AS Package, last_version AS Installed, fixed_version AS "Fixed in", scope AS Scope, scope_id AS Root, confidence AS Confidence, status AS Status, first_seen AS "First seen" | sort 0 Host, Package

viz.option: Nothing in this fleet matches this CVE. That means no host reports an affected package at an affected version, not that the fleet is immune: check Coverage for what the feed cannot assess.

panel.title: What the feed says is affected

search.query: | inputlookup riskability_ranges_lookup where cve_id="$cve_tok$" | eval Introduced = if(introduced="", "any earlier version", introduced) | eval Fixed = case(fixed != "", fixed, last_affected != "", "no fix; last affected " . last_affected, 1=1, "no fix published") | eval Distribution = trim(distro . " " . distro_release) | stats values(Fixed) AS Fixed, values(Introduced) AS Introduced BY ecosystem, package, Distribution | rename ecosystem AS Ecosystem, package AS Package | sort 0 Ecosystem, Package, Distribution

viz.option: No affected ranges for this CVE in the bundle.

search.query: | inputlookup riskability_advisories_lookup where cve_id="$cve_tok$" | eval Reference = if(url != "", url, "") | table feed_source, advisory_id, Reference, kev_notes | rename feed_source AS Source, advisory_id AS "Advisory id", kev_notes AS "CISA notes" | sort 0 Source

viz.option: No advisory rows for this CVE.

div.span: One CVE usually has several advisories: the upstream one, plus one per distribution that shipped a fix. They disagree about version numbers on purpose, because each describes its own packaging.
